article.title: Presentment for payment of promissory note payable by instalments.
article.content: A promissory note payable by instalments must be presented for payment on the third day after the date fixed for payment of each instalment; and non-payment on such presentment has the same effect as non-payment of a note at maturity.
article.html:
67Presentment for payment of promissory note payable by instalments.

Section 67 · Chapter V · page 17 of the Act

A promissory note payable by instalments must be presented for payment on the third day after the date fixed for payment of each instalment; and non-payment on such presentment has the same effect as non-payment of a note at maturity.
